support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH with Handelsregister number HRB 88421 unchanged, linking the MSA-OAK-2018 counterparty name to the billed entity name.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet supplies establishing evidence—not mere name compatibility—that the counterparty named in contract MSA-OAK-2018 (Oakfield Logistics GmbH) and the entity billed as Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal counterparty following a documented rebrand with unchanged registration number; the packet does not preserve competing candidates or state that identity cannot be established.
